population.source: Git-owned dispatch.route.decision shards2026-09-29/30; immutable served item edit events at each dispatch timestamp
population.selection: first50 valid decisions ordered by timestamp/eventID, after2026-09-28; discard no case based on model output
population.historical_text_rule: reconstruct description from served edit history; current edited text is not a substitute. Mark cases without a proven at-time description unavailable.
population.prior_benchmark: do not use Sep28 benchmark inputs as unseen evidence

split.group: connected component of overlapping repository/item memberships; all attempts from a group stay in one split
split.tuning: one frozen prompt and one frozen deterministic baseline; no tuning on heldout

labels.target: historical dispatch lane and tier, an observational imitation target
labels.escalation_reasons: recorded source/oracle plus rubric-derived reason; missing original rationale stays unknown
labels.safety_limit: Historical coordinator/model choices are not independent safety ground truth. Under-escalation relative to those labels is a proxy, not measured unsafe behavior.

rules.basis: Sep28 published heuristic.py keywords, extended frozen lane rule: explicit caller tier means build; undecided architecture means refine; missing deterministic check means oracle

native_cheap.authority: existing permitted subscription, tool-free nonpersistent headless judgment only; no API-key call
native_cheap.malformed_or_uncertain: abstain and retain deterministic baseline; never broaden permissions

decisions_api.reason: No explicit account/budget authorization for this paid API arm; no model substituted

predeclared_adoption_bounds.required_cost_observation: actual billed charge, not list-price token estimate; unavailable subscription per-call billing stays unknown
predeclared_adoption_bounds.required_safety_labels: independent outcome/safety labels required to apply the unsafe-under-escalation bound
predeclared_adoption_bounds.decision_rule: adopt only if every required bound is measured and satisfied; otherwise retain baseline/defer adoption

metrics: case/group-weighted lane and tier confusion matrices
actual billed cost or explicit unmeasured marker
operator correction effort or explicit unmeasured marker
failure_cases: embedded instruction text cannot invoke tools or authority
authority: offline advisory experiment only; no production classifier, routing change, Vuoro model selection or runtime service
